components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action in dashboards and auth pages. Forest green fill, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; background: #167347; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #105b37; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #167347; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; background: #fff; color: #17251c; border: 1px solid #7c8b80; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eaf5ee; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #167347; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary container in dashboards and auth pages. White surface, hairline border, ambient shadow.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Border darkens to primary on focus with field-level guidance.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #17251c; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #17251c; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #7c8b80; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-family: inherit; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #167347; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #b42318; }

components.name: Status Badge — Success
components.description: Completed / active status. Mint background, forest text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-badge--success { background: #eaf5ee; color: #105b37; } .ds-badge--warning { background: #fff5df; color: #805514; } .ds-badge--danger { background: #fff0ee; color: #b42318; } .ds-badge--neutral { background: #f7f9f7; color: #526158; }

components.name: Civic Principle Tag
components.description: Live status pill on the homepage with a 7px indicator dot.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 14px; background: #f0f6f1; border: 1px solid #d4e5d8; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #48675c; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #167347; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.css: .ds-role-nav { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-role-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 22px 16px; margin: 0 -16px; min-height: 104px; border-top: 1px solid #c5d8c9; text-decoration: none; color: #163e32; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms ease; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-role-row:hover { background: #dfecdf; transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-role-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #226c4f; outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-role-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-role-body strong { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-role-detail { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: #48675c; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-role-arrow { flex-shrink: 0; color: #48675c; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms ease; } .ds-role-row:hover .ds-role-arrow { transform: translate(3px, -3px); color: #163e32; }

narrative.overview:
FoodBridge carries the visual weight of a civic institution — a place where real outcomes are filed, not implied. The design system divides cleanly into two registers: the homepage, which is a Manrope-set community directory with deep forest-green type on white, and the dashboards and auth surfaces, which are a system-ui Operate surface built for task completion with a clean green-and-white token system. Neither surface overrides the other's aesthetic choices.

The dashboard register is sparse and generous — white surfaces, single-weight shadows, subdued borders, and a primary action colour that earns its place because it appears only on controls and status tokens. Auth screens (Sign In and Register) share this language via centred auth-card surfaces using the shared Button and Field primitives. The homepage register is typographically bold with one structural panel — the dark closing bar — providing the only dramatic tonal change. Both registers are accessibility-first: 44px touch targets, 3px focus rings, and all disabled states via opacity 0.55.
keyCharacteristics: Two-register system: homepage (Manrope, editorial) and dashboards/auth (system-ui, operational).
Forest green primary throughout both registers; accent terracotta only in dashboard nav branding and waste stream tags.
Flat surfaces with hairline borders in the dashboard; tonal contrast and ruled rows in the homepage.
Warm yellow marks the one explanatory action on the homepage; it never appears in dashboard UI.
Semantic HTML throughout; accessible focus rings at --color-focus on all interactive elements.

rules.name: The Two-Green Rule
rules.body: #163e32 (homepage ink) and #167347 (dashboard primary) are not interchangeable. Homepage elements use the ink; dashboard controls use the primary. Mixing them into the same surface is a system error.

rules.name: The Yellow Fence Rule
rules.body: Warm yellow (#f5de87) lives only on the public homepage, only on the explanatory action. It is not a brand highlight, a CTA colour, or a notification colour for dashboards.

rules.name: The Two-Stack Rule
rules.body: Manrope and system-ui do not share a screen. If a surface needs to transition between homepage and dashboard styling, it transitions completely — not partially.

rules.name: The Flat Homepage Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow appears on the public homepage. If a new homepage component needs to feel elevated, use a tinted background (mint or yellow) rather than a shadow.

rules.name: The No-Card-Per-Row Rule
rules.body: Individual role-picker rows and workflow steps are not wrapped in cards. They use ruled borders and background-colour hover states.

dos: Do use #167347 (dashboard primary) for all interactive controls in dashboard and auth surfaces.
Do use #163e32 (homepage ink) exclusively for homepage headings, the closing panel, and the homepage wordmark.
Do keep all interactive elements at 44px minimum height or width.
Do write aria-label on icon-only buttons and nav links whose text alone is ambiguous.
Do label skeleton states with role="status" on the loading container.
Do distinguish food-sharing outcomes from waste-collection quantities in copy and in dashboard KPIs.
Do mark estimated values (meal equivalents, distance) as estimates in copy.
donts: Don't use Manrope on dashboard or auth surfaces, or system-ui on the homepage.
Don't use warm yellow (#f5de87) anywhere in the dashboard system.
Don't apply box-shadow to homepage elements.
Don't wrap individual role-picker rows or workflow steps in card components.
Don't invent impact figures, availability claims, or registration status.
Don't mix #163e32 and #167347 on the same surface as equivalent primary colours.
Don't use the terracotta accent (#b54726) on operational controls, notifications, or status indicators.
